doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Copies of the photo for the Brunies boys; how Laine paid them
summary: Blanche explains getting copies made for Merritt, Abbie and Georgie, estimating Georgie's age, and Laine says how he paid the boys, mothers getting the money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
